condition: Asplenia after emergency splenectomy — vaccination and prophylaxis
permutationLabel: Post-operative clinic, day 14 after trauma splenectomy, no vaccines given
summary: 24-year-old man 14 days after emergency splenectomy for a grade IV splenic injury (motorcycle), seen in the post-operative clinic; no vaccines were given before discharge. BSH 2011: pneumococcal, Hib, meningococcal and annual influenza vaccination, antibiotic prophylaxis and alert card.

inputs.hpi: Day 14 after emergency laparotomy and splenectomy for a grade IV splenic injury in a motorcycle collision. Recovering well, eating normally, wound healing. Discharged on day 6 without vaccinations or antibiotic prophylaxis. Travels to Guyana for work.

exam.abdomen: Midline wound healed, no collection, soft.

surgicalHistory: Emergency laparotomy and splenectomy (grade IV splenic injury) — 14 days ago

confirmedDiagnosis.name: Asplenia after traumatic splenectomy — post-operative review
confirmedDiagnosis.assessmentText: Day 14 after splenectomy for trauma, recovering well. Asplenia: pneumococcal, Hib, meningococcal ACWY and B vaccines now, annual influenza; antibiotic prophylaxis and standby antibiotics; alert card; malaria advice for travel.

mustInclude.note: Overwhelming post-splenectomy infection is largely pneumococcal: vaccination at ≥ 2 weeks after emergency splenectomy is a patient-safety item.
mustInclude.knownGapNote: No management output at all: Z90.81 (asplenia) maps to no protocol, so the Assessment panel and Plan are empty. Post-splenectomy vaccines exist only in the splenic_laceration protocol (S36 prefixes), which a follow-up coded as asplenia never reaches; no prompt reads 'splenectomy' in the surgical history.
mustInclude.proposedFix: Add an asplenia prompt triggered by 'splenectomy' in the surgical history or D73.0/Z90.81: pneumococcal, Hib, MenACWY and MenB, annual influenza, antibiotic prophylaxis and standby course, alert card (BSH 2011 / Green Book ch. 7).

mustExclude.note: An ACS, PE or AF antithrombotic/thrombolytic plan must never be attached to this diagnosis. Regression guard for DiagnosisRadiationEngine keyword matching: before 999f838 (word-boundary lookup) the first-substring match would have attached the pulmonary-embolism (DOAC, thrombolysis) plan to this diagnosis because "pe" is inside "post-operative". With word-boundary matching no radiation entry matches (simulated from the source), so iOS is expected to pass; to be confirmed on the first iOS CI run.

guideline.name: BCSH (BSH) guideline — prevention and treatment of infection in patients with an absent or dysfunctional spleen
guideline.section: Pneumococcal, Haemophilus influenzae type b and meningococcal immunisation and annual influenza vaccine; after emergency splenectomy immunise from 2 weeks post-operatively (or before discharge if follow-up is uncertain); lifelong antibiotic prophylaxis offered (at least in the first 2 years) and standby antibiotics; patient education and alert card
guideline.citation: Davies JM, Lewis MPN, Wimperis J, et al. Review of guidelines for the prevention and treatment of infection in patients with an absent or dysfunctional spleen: prepared on behalf of the British Committee for Standards in Haematology. Br J Haematol. 2011;155:308–317.

rationale: Asplenic patients carry a lifelong risk of overwhelming post-splenectomy infection. When vaccines were missed at discharge, the post-operative visit is the safety net.
